answer: Make continuity expensive instead of mere existence. Each identity must extend a sequential VDF seeded by the epoch beacon; that work cannot be parallelised or shared, so bulk-registered keys buy nothing. A pearl of lineage only mints by extending an unbroken chain, and skipping an epoch burns it. Cloning into N identities means N separate unbroken chains, N times the wall-clock cost, for a pool split N ways. The juniper graft fails because a graft can copy a branch but not the trellis of shared history underneath it.
